verdict.rationale: telli documents a 'Test call' dialog in the agent builder where you can pick an unsaved draft or any saved revision and review the recording alongside the transcript. That lets you test agent changes before rollout, but nothing shows a separate sandbox environment, test API keys, or isolation from production contacts and call data. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment, sandbox API keys or a test mode for the REST API and webhooks, explicit separation from production data, and independent corroboration.
